high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Screen Rant, featuring a quote by Matt Reeves, the director of "The Batman." The quote reads: "...people are going like, 'Well, we've seen it, so what do you got for us?' So how can it be the thing we love, but also something we haven't seen? That's always the challenge. So with a character like that, that would have to be the bar." This quote is attributed to Matt Reeves on Barry Keoghan's Joker. The background of the image shows a close-up of two characters.
